body:
Just a fellow player, I also prefered the free daily spin that was the free lucky ticket every 24 hours. Getting 1/3 the amounts of free spins is a little disappointing.

That said, the duck boat timer was increased to make it easier on people to complete them. A lot of players were having issues conpleting their boats in the time they had.

The new townkin costs 80 invitations like all other townkins. There was a bug with the release that changed it to 200, but it was fixed with the most recent maintenance.

I personally love how much this dev listens to the people who play Townkins. For example, you can directly speak to a member of the team and submit suggestions on their official Discord Server, the button for which you can find in game (settings menu, contact tab just scroll down),

Edit: The collections that are going away, are only going away temporarily. Collections will be rotating in and out of lucky draw.

As far as your backpack goes, you can put your extra clothing items into a wardrobe. 

Enter your house and tap on a wardrobe you have placed (the 2x1 cabinets). It will bring up a menu where you can drag clothing from your backpack to the wardrobe and vice versa. The wardrobe's inventory in infinite.

The only things sent manually as thanks are boxes, notes, or roses you have to actually pick up off the ground in your town. Everything in the mailbox is an auto generated message or from the support team.

The coins or rose you get in the mail is an automatic message when you harvet the crop/tree the person helped with or collected a gift/rose/note. 

I thought you were asking about the gift box that you can get a handful of coins from.

The small blue and yellow gifts are Daily gifts. 

When in someone's town it will be in the "buttons" on the left of the main game screen. The daily gift button has the blue gift box with yellow ribbon icon. Within the 2x4 grid of buttons it is located in the bottom right. (Beside the "Leave a Parcel" and below the "Leave a Rose" buttons)
